glosses: The condition or feeling of being safe; security; certainty.

examples.text: If you push it to the limit, safety is not guaranteed.
He managed to reach the border and escape to safety.
Oh, oh! “Go to safety”! Why didn’t I think of that⁉ Here I am in danger when, really, I could simply be going to safety! I shouldn’t have wasted your time by calling in the first place!

examples.text: Be sure that the safety is set before proceeding.

glosses: Preservation from escape; close custody.

examples.text: He sacked the quarterback in the end zone for a safety.

glosses: Any of the defensive players who are in position furthest from the line of scrimmage and whose responsibility is to defend against passes as well as to be the tacklers of last resort.

examples.text: The free safety made a game-saving tackle on the runner who had broken past the linebackers.

glosses: A safety squeeze.

examples.text: Boy wondered about that bunt. He had a notion Fowler would commit himself soon because time was on the go. But Fowler didn’t, making it another sweep of three Pirates. He had thus far given up only two safeties.

glosses: A safety shot or sequence of such shots.

examples.text: That was a poor safety from Higgins.

La sûreté est l’ensemble des moyens que l’on prend pour qu’une installation, un appareil, etc., fonctionnent bien, pour prévenir les accidents ou en limiter les effets. La sécurité, par contre, est l’ensemble des mesures que l’on prend pour assurer la protection des personnes et des biens contre les dangers et nuisances résultant de la création, du fonctionnement ou de l’arrêt des installations ou encore du transport, de l’utilisation ou de la transformation de substances dangereuses.
